name: internals.scss
html:
<pre class="docs-code"><code class="lang-scss">// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  internals.scss — the "internals" chrome shared by the project detail page
//  and the legal pages: centered title, the case-study content column, media
//  figure sizing contracts (--mf-w/--mf-h passed to <media-figure>), and the
//  internal footer panel (rounded card on --bg-secondary).
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

@import '../../base/variables';
@import '../../base/mixins';
@import '../../base/fonts';
@import '../../base/placeholders';
@import '../../base/structure';

// ── Internals chrome — project detail + legal pages: title, content column, media contracts, footer panel.
.internal {
  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-lg;
    @extend .ttl-special;

    padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
    text-align: center;

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-4xl) 0 to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl);
    }
  }

  &-main {
    @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    // No max-height/overflow here — the section must not clip its own padding.
    // The 70vh constraint lives inside the media-figure Shadow DOM (figure element).
    padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-xl);
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-5xl);
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-6xl);
    }

    figure {
      position: relative;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;
      max-height: 70vh;
      max-height: 70dvh;
      overflow: hidden;
      margin: 0 auto;
      -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
      border-radius: to-rem($space-md);

      @include layout-1024() {
        -webkit-border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
        border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      }
    }

    .render-placeholder {
      display: block;
      position: relative;
      height: auto;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 100%;

      @include layout-768() {
        width: auto;
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 70vh;
        max-height: 70dvh;
      }
    }

    .render-media {
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;

      &--thumb {
        filter: blur(12px);
        transform: scale(1.05);
        z-index: 1;
        // Mobile: filter:blur triggers paint every frame — extremely expensive on mobile GPU.
        // Replace with a simple opacity dim while the hi-res loads.
        @media (max-width: 768px) {
          filter: none;
          transform: none;
          opacity: 0.4;
        }
      }

      &--high {
        opacity: 0;
        z-index: 2;
        transition: opacity 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);

        &.render-media--loaded {
          opacity: 1;
        }
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      }
    }
  }

  // Cover skeleton (before data loads)
  .skeleton-cover {
    background: linear-gradient(
      90deg,
      var(--skel-bg-1) 25%,
      var(--skel-bg-2) 50%,
      var(--skel-bg-3) 75%
    );
    background-size: 200% 100%;
    animation: skeleton-shimmer 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    display: block;
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      animation: none;
      background: var(--skel-bg-1);
    }
  }

  &-description {
    @extend %MAXAREA;

    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
    padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
    // Min-height matches the carousel item height, set as a CSS var by Carousel.vue
    min-height: var(--carousel-item-height, auto);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    contain: layout style;

    @include layout-768() {
      // 1 col indent per side on 8-col grid (1/8 = 12.5%)
      padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
      padding-left: 12.5%;
      padding-right: 12.5%;
    }

    @include layout-1024() {
      // 3 cols indent per side on 12-col grid (3/12 = 25%) → content in cols 4–9
      padding-top: to-rem($space-4xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
      padding-left: 25%;
      padding-right: 25%;
    }

    @include layout-1920() {
      padding-top: to-rem($space-5xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }

    @include layout-2560() {
      padding-top: to-rem($space-6xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
    }

    .legal & {
      // Legal pages: keep the column-indent padding so content sits in
      // cols 4–9 (3 empty cols on each side of the 12-column grid).
      // The .legal container is full-width (no %MAXAREA), so this
      // 25% padding IS the only source of indentation.
      @include layout-768() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
        // 12.5% = 1.5 cols on 8-col intermediate grid
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
        // 25% already applied by base rule — no override needed
      }

      @include layout-1920() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
      }
    }

    &:last-of-type {
      .legal & {
        @include layout-1024() {
          padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);
        }

        @include layout-1920() {
          padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          padding-bottom: to-rem($space-6xl);
        }
      }
    }

    &-text {
      @extend .txt-md;

      font-family: var(--font-primary);
      font-weight: 250;
      word-break: normal;
      overflow-wrap: break-word;
      hyphens: none;
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      a {
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;
        text-decoration: underline;
        color: var(--black);

        &:hover,
        &:focus {
          opacity: 0.5;
        }

        &:visited {
          text-decoration: line-through;
        }
      }
    }

    p:last-of-type {
      padding-bottom: 0;
    }
  }

  &-extra {
    @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: var(--bg-dark);
    overflow-x: auto;
    scroll-snap-align: center;

    /* width */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar {
      height: to-rem($space-md);

      @include layout-1024() {
        height: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        height: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
    }

    /* Track */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
      background: var(--black);
    }

    /* Handle */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
      border-radius: to-rem(3);
      background: var(--grey-3);
    }

    /* Handle on hover */
    &::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {
      background: var(--grey);
    }

    &-scroll {
      padding: to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl - $space-md);
      display: block;
      white-space: nowrap;
      width: max-content;
      margin: 0 auto;

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-5xl - $space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-3xl - $space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1440() {
        padding: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-4xl - $space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1920() {
        padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-5xl - $space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-2560() {
        padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-5xl - $space-xl);
      }
    }

    &-item {
      position: relative;
      border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
      color: var(--text-muted);
      display: inline-block;
      width: min-content;
      padding: 0 to-rem($space-lg);
      min-height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: 0 to-rem($space-xl);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
      }

      @include layout-1440() {
        padding: 0 to-rem($space-2xl);
      }

      @include layout-1920() {
        padding: 0 to-rem($space-3xl);
      }

      &:first-of-type {
        padding-left: 0;
      }

      &:last-of-type {
        padding-right: 0;
      }

      // ── CSS Custom Properties for media-figure Shadow DOM sizing ──────────────
      // CSS custom properties DO cross shadow boundaries — this is the only way
      // to pass sizing context into <media-figure>'s encapsulated shadow root.
      // media-figure.scss reads --mf-w / --mf-h / --mf-max-w to size the placeholder.
      media-figure,
      figure {
        --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)});
        --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)});
        --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-xl * 2)});

        @include layout-768() {
          --mf-w: calc(90vw - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)});
          --mf-h: calc(70vh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)});
          --mf-h: calc(70dvh - #{to-rem($space-2xl * 2)});
        }

        @include layout-1024() {
          --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-6xl)};
          --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
        }

        @include layout-1440() {
          --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
          --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
          --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-9xl)};
        }
      }

      figure {
        position: relative;
        display: block;
        width: var(--mf-w);
        height: var(--mf-h);
        max-width: var(--mf-max-w, none);
        overflow: hidden;
        border-radius: to-rem($space-md);
        margin: 0;

        @include layout-1024() {
          border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
        }

        .render-placeholder {
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
        }

        // Skeleton slides: overlay the placeholder instead of flowing below it
        .skeleton--media {
          position: absolute;
          inset: 0;
        }
      }

      // landscape variant: the vw cap travels in --mf-w (consumed as the
      // placeholder's max-width) so wide media can use most of the viewport;
      // --mf-max-w mirrors it for the light-DOM figure skeleton contract.
      &.landscape media-figure {
        @include layout-1024() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)});
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-3xl)});
        }

        @include layout-1280() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
        }

        @include layout-1440() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-7xl)});
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-7xl)});
        }

        @include layout-1920() {
          --mf-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-6xl)});
          --mf-max-w: calc(100vw - #{to-rem($space-6xl)});
        }
      }

      // small variant
      &.small media-figure {
        @include layout-1440() {
          --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-6xl)};
          --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-8xl)};
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          --mf-w: #{to-rem($space-7xl)};
          --mf-h: #{to-rem($space-9xl)};
        }
      }

      label {
        @extend .ttl-xs;

        display: block;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        margin: 0;
        font-variant: all-small-caps;
        color: var(--color-white-raw);
      }

      &-open {
        display: none;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        position: fixed;
        background: rgba($color-black, 0.9);
        min-height: 100vh;
        min-height: 100dvh;
        height: auto;
        width: 100vw;
        z-index: 1;

        img {
          box-sizing: border-box;
          padding: to-rem($space-5xl);
          height: auto;
          width: 100%;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  &-expand {
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;
    cursor: pointer;

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      opacity: 0.95;
    }
  }

  &-footer {
    &-title {
      @extend .ttl-lg;
      @extend .ttl-special;

      max-width: to-rem($space-8xl);
      margin: 0 auto;
      text-align: center;
      padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-lg);

      span {
        display: inline-block;
        text-align: center;
      }

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-3xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding: to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-5xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
    }

    &-related {
      @extend %MAXAREA;

      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding-top: to-rem($space-xl);
      padding-bottom: to-rem($space-4xl);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-2xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
      }

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding-top: to-rem($space-3xl);
        padding-bottom: to-rem($space-5xl);
      }
    }

    &-items {
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      // Full-bleed footer stripe spanning the whole viewport width — the
      // links row and the legal disclaimer share the grid's max area.
      box-sizing: border-box;
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      padding: to-rem($space-2xl);
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);

      @include layout-1024() {
        padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-5xl);
      }

      &-separator {
        padding: 0 to-rem($space-md);
        display: none;

        @include layout-375() {
          display: inline-block;
        }

        @include layout-2560() {
          padding: 0 to-rem($space-lg);
        }
      }

      &-link {
        @extend .ttl-xs;

        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;
        cursor: pointer;
        display: block;
        line-height: to-rem($space-3xl);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: 300;

        @include layout-375() {
          text-transform: initial;
          display: inline-block;
        }

        &:hover,
        &:focus {
          opacity: 0.5;
        }

        &.router-link-active {
          text-decoration: underline;
          opacity: 1;
          cursor: pointer;
        }
      }

      &-note {
        @extend .ttl-xxs;
        @extend %MAXAREA;

        // Collapsed: -note-text is justified and clamped to its first line
        // (CSS ellipsis); -note-more renders three dots that pulse while the
        // note is truncated — the "show more" affordance. The element is a
        // real <button> so Enter/Space expand it (aria-expanded + :focus-visible).
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: to-rem($space-2xs);
        clear: both;
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0;
        border: none;
        margin: to-rem($space-md) auto to-rem($space-lg);
        font-family: inherit;
        font-weight: 300;
        line-height: to-rem($space-xl);
        text-align: left;
        color: inherit;
        background: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        // Mobile reads better capitalized (the authored sentence case);
        // the uppercase treatment resumes at tablet/desktop widths.
        text-transform: none;

        @include layout-768() {
          text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        &-text {
          display: -webkit-box;
          -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
          -webkit-line-clamp: 1;
          line-clamp: 1;
          overflow: hidden;
          flex: 1 1 auto;
          min-width: 0;
          text-align: justify;
          text-align-last: left;
          text-decoration: underline;
          text-decoration-color: transparent;
          text-underline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
          transition: text-decoration-color 0.35s ease;
        }

        // Trailing "···" affordance — a bordered pill so it reads as a
        // control, not typographic ellipsis; hidden until JS measures real
        // truncation (is-truncated); dots pulse in a staggered wave.
        &-more {
          flex: none;
          display: inline-flex;
          align-items: center;
          align-self: center;
          gap: to-rem($space-xs);
          padding: to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-sm);
          border: to-rem($space-3xs) solid var(--border-color);
          border-radius: var(--radius-round);
          transform: translateY(to-rem($space-3xs));
          opacity: 0;
          transition:
            opacity 0.3s ease,
            transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
            border-color 0.3s ease;
        }

        &-dot {
          width: to-rem($space-xs);
          height: to-rem($space-xs);
          border-radius: var(--radius-round);
          background: currentColor;
          animation: note-dot-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;

          &:nth-child(2) {
            animation-delay: 0.25s;
          }

          &:nth-child(3) {
            animation-delay: 0.5s;
          }
        }

        &.is-truncated &-more {
          opacity: 0.85;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }

        &.is-open {
          display: block;
        }

        &.is-open &-text {
          display: block;
          overflow: visible;
          text-decoration: none;
        }

        &.is-open &-more {
          display: none;
        }

        &:hover,
        &:focus-visible {
          color: var(--color-accent-contrast);
        }

        &:hover &-text,
        &:focus-visible &-text {
          text-decoration-color: currentColor;
        }

        &:hover &-more,
        &:focus-visible &-more {
          opacity: 1;
          border-color: var(--border-item-hover);
        }

        &:active &-more {
          transform: translateY(0) scale(0.92);
        }
      }
    }

    // Docs-portal entry — a dedicated footer area below the legal links:
    // untranslated English title, localized "English only" description.
    &-docs {
      @extend .ttl-xs;

      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: to-rem($space-3xs);
      width: 100%;
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-2xl) to-rem($space-xl);
      text-align: center;
      color: var(--text-primary);
      background: var(--bg-secondary);

      &-link {
        @extend .ttl-xs;

        color: inherit;
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: to-rem($space-3xs);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-weight: 300;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease-in;

        &:hover,
        &:focus {
          opacity: 0.5;
        }
      }

      &-desc {
        @extend .ttl-xxs;

        opacity: 0.7;
      }
    }
  }
}

// Three-dot pulse for the disclaimer "more" affordance — each dot eases
// between dim and full ink; nth-child delays stagger the wave.
@keyframes note-dot-pulse {
  0%,
  100% {
    opacity: 0.25;
  }

  50% {
    opacity: 1;
  }
}

// ── Mosaic Layout for Related Projects (Zero Empty Gaps) ──────────────────────
$_B_RELATED: 'related-mosaic';

// Related-projects strip at the bottom of the project page.
.#{$_B_RELATED} {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: to-rem($space-md);
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);

  @include layout-768() {
    gap: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  &-item {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    overflow: hidden;
    border-radius: to-rem($space-lg);
    flex: 1 1 100%;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 100%;
    min-height: to-rem(160);
    aspect-ratio: 16 / 10;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    background: var(--bg-secondary);
    box-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-lg) rgba($color-black, 0.15);
    transition:
      transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      box-shadow 0.35s ease;

    // Mobile: always full-width (base styles: flex: 1 1 100%; width: 100%; max-width: 100%)

    // Tablet: enforce exactly 2 columns — 50% minus half the row gap
    @include layout-768() {
      flex: 0 0 calc(50% - #{to-rem($space-lg)} / 2);
      max-width: calc(50% - #{to-rem($space-lg)} / 2);
      min-height: to-rem(190);
    }

    // Desktop: standard mosaic width
    @include layout-1024() {
      flex: 1 1 to-rem(260);
      max-width: to-rem(360);
      min-height: to-rem(200);
    }

    &.router-link-active {
      display: none;
    }

    // Featured items are wider ONLY on desktop (1024px+); ignored on mobile and tablet
    &--featured {
      @include layout-1024() {
        flex: 2 1 to-rem(560);
        max-width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
      }
    }

    &:hover,
    &:focus {
      transform: translateY(#{to-rem(-$space-xs)}) scale(1.01);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-card-hover);

      .#{$_B_RELATED}-img {
        transform: scale(1.06);
      }

      .#{$_B_RELATED}-title {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
      }
    }
  }

  &-media {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    overflow: hidden;
  }

  &-img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    object-position: center;
    display: block;
    transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);
  }

  &-overlay {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: linear-gradient(
      to top,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.88) 0%,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35) 50%,
      rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 100%
    );
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  &-info {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    padding: to-rem($space-md) to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-lg);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 0;
    text-align: left;
    pointer-events: none;

    @include layout-768() {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-xl);
    }

    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item--featured & {
      padding: to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-lg) to-rem($space-xl);

      @include layout-768() {
        padding: to-rem($space-xl) to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
    }
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-sm;

    font-family: var(--font-primary);
    font-weight: 200;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: to-rem(0.8);
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    text-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-2xs) to-rem($space-md) rgba($color-black, 0.6);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease;

    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item--featured & {
      font-size: to-rem($space-lg);

      @include layout-768() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-xl);
      }
      @include layout-1024() {
        font-size: to-rem($space-2xl);
      }
    }
  }

  &-desc {
    @extend .txt-xs;

    font-weight: 200;
    color: var(--color-white-raw);
    text-shadow: 0 to-rem($space-hairline) to-rem($space-sm) var(--bg-dark);
    max-height: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition:
      max-height 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1),
      margin-top 0.25s ease,
      opacity 0.25s ease;

    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item:hover &,
    .#{$_B_RELATED}-item:focus-within & {
      max-height: to-rem($space-5xl);
      margin-top: to-rem($space-2xs);
      opacity: 1;
    }
  }
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Carousel context overrides
// Each .internal-extra-item is the sole child of its .carousel-slide, so
// :first-of-type and :last-of-type both match every item — zeroing out the
// padding on both sides. Restore symmetric padding here so items have visible
// gaps between them in the carousel track.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.carousel .internal-extra-item {
  @include layout-1024() {
    // Desktop clearance: ≥24px margin on each side of the item — combined
    // with the item padding this keeps every media box (and its
    // click-to-open affordance) visually separated from neighbours.
    margin-inline: to-rem(24);
  }

  &:first-of-type {
    padding-left: to-rem($space-lg);
  }
  &:last-of-type {
    padding-right: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  @include layout-768() {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: to-rem($space-xl);
    }
  }

  @include layout-1440() {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: to-rem($space-2xl);
    }
  }

  @include layout-1920() {
    &:first-of-type {
      padding-left: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
    &:last-of-type {
      padding-right: to-rem($space-3xl);
    }
  }
}

// Non-visible carousel slide placeholder: centre the loading spinner
.carousel-slide--loading {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Single landscape image (not in carousel — carousel-fallback)
// Must have the same MAXAREA lateral padding as all other grid content.
// ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
.carousel-fallback {
  @extend %SKEL_DARK_SURFACE;

  padding: to-rem($space-2xl) 0;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
}

.carousel-fallback .internal-extra-item.landscape {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  box-sizing: border-box;
}

// Parallax effect removed: sections render with full opacity and normal layout flow
.project section {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
}

// ── Legal page container ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
// Needs %MAXAREA for width:100% + position:relative + box-sizing on the host.
// BUT horizontal padding is reset to 0 at all breakpoints so the grid indent
// comes entirely from .internal-description's own 25% padding (cols 4–9).
.legal {
  @extend %MAXAREA;

  box-sizing: border-box;
  // Reset all MAXAREA horizontal padding — .internal-description provides
  // the 12.5% / 25% column-indent itself, so no outer indent is needed here.
  padding-left: 0;
  padding-right: 0;

  @include layout-320() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-375() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-414() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
  @include layout-540() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;

  @include layout-768() {

  @include layout-960() {

  @include layout-1024() {
    padding-left: 0;

  @include layout-1280() {

  @include layout-2560() {
    padding-left: 0;
    padding-right: 0;
  }
}
